harness.rotation: gpqa_treatment_order position-balanced rotation over the 12 frozen cases

notes: A green pilot verifies the case-to-observation-to-scoring pipeline only.
It admits no Fugu parity, product-quality, latency, token, or intelligence claim.

GPQA-Diamond was retired as an evaluation direction long before this pilot; it is bound here solely because it carried pre-pinned, license-clean case provenance and a no-tool exact-match judge, making it the minimum-infrastructure harness-link vehicle. It must not be read as reinstating GPQA as an evaluation direction, and any successor authority must bind genuine agentic benchmarks.
Per-run model-call accounting is a best-effort lower bound derived from recorded usage because the external-effect report does not persist per-call counts.
The consumed one-shot authorities (V12, Delivery Verification v1-v4, Goal 3E) remain unchanged and are not rerun by this protocol.
